summary: Checkpoint 3 end-to-end frontend flow validated on public Expo web preview at 390x844. Home → New Assessment → Patient Details → Questionnaire (13 questions) → Review → Assessment Setup → Camera (live path with granted permission) → Assessment Summary → History → Reopen from history → Home all worked. Metrics stay '--' everywhere, quality shows 'Not available', 'Not a diagnosis' disclaimer present, no risk % or fake numbers. Home HISTORY tile updates from 'No assessments yet' to '1 saved'. History card shows 'Camera metrics: Not available'. One minor React-Native deprecation warning surfaced (pointerEvents prop).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/camera-assessment.tsx:195 (pointerEvents="box-none" prop on <View>). Move it into the style object.

action_items: Migrate `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` on the camera overlay View in /app/frontend/app/camera-assessment.tsx:195 to silence RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Assessment Summary shows 'Camera session: 2s' (numeric seconds) in the info grid. This is session DURATION, not a movement metric, so it does not violate the 'no fake numbers in metric slots' rule — all six metric slots correctly stay '--'. Flagging for awareness in case the product spec wants durations hidden too.
history.tsx uses `router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/')`. When navigated to via `router.replace('/history')` from the summary, this behaves correctly. Good.
camera-assessment.tsx `phase === 'waiting'` disables BEGIN TEST until `onCameraReady`; on web with granted permission the callback fires and state moved to READY as expected.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage at test start; created one assessment (patient 'Test Patient', knee, sit-to-stand) during the run. Left in browser storage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright can grant camera permission via `context.grant_permissions(['camera'], origin=...)` and expo-camera's useCameraPermissions honours it — the CameraView reaches onCameraReady and the state badge shows READY. This lets the full BEGIN TEST → COMPLETE & SAVE path be exercised in headless. Also note that only `test-option-sit_to_stand` chip was verified as present; `test-option-timed_up_and_go` was not found on the setup screen, which may mean MOVEMENT_TESTS currently exports a subset (verify /app/frontend/src/types/assessment.ts). This did not block the flow.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs reproduced. The transient 'locator resolved to 2 elements' on `[data-testid="home-screen"]` after `router.replace('/')` from summary is the same routing double-mount previously noted in iteration 1 and is not a functional defect.
